ruleDefinitions.name: PowerShell Web Access Feature Enabled Via DISM
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the use of DISM to enable the PowerShell Web Access feature, which could be used for remote access and potential abuse

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\dism\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "DISM\.EXE") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*WindowsPowerShellWebAccess.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/online.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/enable\\-feature.*")))
